candidate.derivedAnswer: A. All lines in the plane, with perpendicularity understood by direction.
candidate.answerReason: Line-plane perpendicularity means perpendicularity to every direction in the plane. An in-plane line need not intersect the perpendicular line.

methods.label: Use the definition
methods.explanation: By definition, a line perpendicular to a plane is perpendicular to every line in that plane.
methods.levelReason: The definition directly answers this required solid-geometry question.
